other.name: Fire-pit scrolls
other.how_it_works: Orange xWays (2–4 same symbol); Red Infectious Wild (symbol→all Wild); Grey xSplit (split row, double size → Wild; not self/Bonus).

other.name: Dead Man’s March
other.how_it_works: After xNudge fully visible: move 1 left +1 mult; at reel 1 transfer mult to nearest other xNudge; continues until last reaches reel 1.

wilds.name: xNudge® Wild
wilds.behavior: Stacked; nudge +1; then March left +1/step; transfer at reel 1.

wilds.name: Infectious Wild
wilds.behavior: From red scroll: chosen symbol instances → Wild.

scatters.name: Bonus / Gold Bonus
scatters.behavior: 3/4/5 Bonus → 3/4/5 Dead Man’s Gold; Gold Bonus → Reaper’s Gold same counts. Counted on Bonus board.

multipliers.name: xNudge March mult
multipliers.behavior: +1 per nudge and per March step.

collectors.name: Collector coin
collectors.behavior: Collects all active coin values when collected (Dead Man’s Gold).

specials.name: Cloner / Multiplier / King’s Grace coins
specials.behavior: Clone highest; double all; reset spin count. Reaper’s: feature coins trigger on land.

base_game_loop.summary: 5×3 ways; fire-pit scrolls; xNudge March. 3–5 Bonus → Dead Man’s Gold coin hold-and-win on 5×5; Gold Bonus → Reaper’s Gold (features on land). Boosters 1.5×/2.5×/5×/40×. Extra Spin. Cap 25,313×.

phases.name: Bonus check
phases.what_happens: Bonus board → Dead Man’s / Reaper’s Gold.

base_game_loop.win_evaluation: Ways after xWays/xSplit/Wilds; bonus pays coin clusters.

modes.name: Dead Man’s Gold
modes.retrigger: Coin land keeps spin count; King’s Grace resets to initial.
modes.end_condition: No spins left or 25,313×; optional Extra Spin.

phases.name: Coin grid
phases.what_happens: Coins land; 3+ aligned V/H collected; Collector/Cloner/Multiplier/King’s Grace when collected.

modes.effects: Hold-and-win coins; feature coins on collect.

modes.name: Reaper’s Gold
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Feature coins trigger as soon as they land.

phases.name: Enter
phases.what_happens: Same as Dead Man’s Gold but features on land.

bonus_free_spins.notes: xTra Extra Spin keeps symbol mult state if cost ≤ prior win.

features.name: Booster 1
features.effects: More Dead Man’s Gold; +1–4 Bonus to board when ≥1 lands.

features.name: Booster 3
features.effects: More Reaper’s; +1–4 Gold Bonus when ≥1 lands.

ante_bet.notes: Boosters used instead of classic ante.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: 5×3; fire-pit scrolls xWays/Infectious Wild/xSplit; xNudge Dead Man’s March; 3–5 Bonus → Dead Man’s Gold 3–5 spins (5×5 coins); Gold Bonus → Reaper’s Gold; boosters 1.5–40×; max 25,313×.
